# FLX-3705: a calibration parameter rests on a source a fit may not move

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A fit moves only what the data does not state. A parameter the calibration block names has to be a number the parameter register lists with the source assumption or default; a value the pinned profile or the contract states (the source profile or contract), or one an earlier fit already calibrated, is refused. The message names the document, the pointer and the source. Remove the parameter from calibration.parameters, or state the number as an assumption in the register if it is one. Nothing was run.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3705
```
